title: Pokerlog Wiki
text: Everything about using Pokerlog, the poker session tracker for iPhone: logging cash games and tournaments, running a live session, recording hands, reading your statistics and keeping your bankroll in order. New here? Start with Your first session. Can't find an answer? Search above, read the FAQ or contact support.

title: Install Pokerlog
text: Pokerlog runs on iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Download First launch A short welcome walks you through reminders and shows what Pro adds. You can skip any step and change it later in Settings.

title: Your first session
headings: Log a session you already played
Track a session as you play
text: A session is one sitting at a table: where you played, the game, what you put in and what you took out. The Sessions tab with a list of cash games and tournaments Log a session you already played Tap New Session on the Sessions tab and answer the steps one by one: place, game, buy-in, cash-out, and when. The result is worked out for you. Track a session as you play Start a live session before you sit down. See Live session.

title: Currency, places and stakes
text: Places A place is a casino, a club, a home game or an online room. Each place remembers its currency and your usual game. Currency Stakes and games Blinds and ante for cash games, the buy-in for tournaments, and the table size from heads-up to 10-max.

title: Add a session
text: The steps 1. Place: where you played. The last place is suggested. 2. Game: cash game or tournament, the game, blinds or the tournament name, the table size. 3. Bought in: everything you put on the table. 4. Cashed out: what you left with. 5. When: today by default; the time is optional. Recent games When you start a new session, Pokerlog offers up to five games you played lately, so a regular game takes a couple of taps.

title: Live session
text: A live session runs a clock while you play and keeps the session on your Lock Screen. The Overview tab with a live cash session running for two hours Start Add-ons, rebuys and breaks Finish

title: Edit and delete
text: Edit a session Open the session and tap Edit. The summary opens straight away, so you change only the line you need. Delete a session

title: Cash games vs tournaments
text: Cash games Profit is what you cashed out minus everything you bought in. Rates per hour and per 100 big blinds use the session's blinds. Tournaments You record the buy-in, the place you finished, the field size and the prize. Re-entries, add-ons, bounties and selling a share are Pro. Re-entries, add-ons, bounties, prize pools and selling a share of a tournament are part of Pro.

title: Record a hand
text: The hand recorder writes a hand street by street: seats, cards, actions and the showdown. Start a hand Tap Record a Hand on the Hands tab, or record one from a live session. Actions Tags and notes

title: Smart Hand: dictate a hand
text: Smart Hand lets you dictate a hand in your own words. Pokerlog turns it into a recorded hand and asks about anything it missed. How to dictate Check and fix Privacy The recording is sent to a speech service to be transcribed only when you tap Send. See the Privacy Policy.

title: Statistics overview
text: The Statistics tab answers one question: where you win. The Statistics tab with net profit over time and key metrics All, Cash, Tournaments Filters Period, live or online, place and game. In Free, statistics cover the last 30 days. Pro opens any period, the filters and the breakdowns.

title: What each metric means
headings: Hourly rate in BB and BB/100
text: Net profit Everything you cashed out minus everything you put in, over the chosen period. Net hourly rate Net profit divided by the hours played. Hourly rate in BB and BB/100 Your result in big blinds per hour, and per 100 hands where hands are known. Winning sessions The share of sessions that finished above zero. ROI For tournaments: profit divided by the total buy-ins. ITM The share of tournaments where you finished in the money. Standard deviation per hour How much your hourly results swing. Drawdown The biggest drop from a peak in your results.

title: Your bankroll
text: Your bankroll is the money you keep for poker. Session results are added to it automatically; deposits and withdrawals you add yourself. Balance Deposits and withdrawals Low bankroll warning Pokerlog compares your bankroll with your usual buy-in and warns you when the cushion gets thin.

title: Several bankrolls and currencies
text: Why several For example, one bankroll for live games and one for online, or one per currency. Transfers Currencies The first bankroll is free. More bankrolls and transfers between them are part of Pro.

title: Widgets and Live Activity
text: Home Screen widgets Lock Screen and Dynamic Island A running live session shows its clock and result on the Lock Screen. Controls

title: Limits and breaks
text: Limits you set for yourself. Pokerlog never blocks anything; it tells you, at the right moment, when you reach a limit you chose. Stop-loss Breaks Monthly limit Tilt signal All of this is free.

title: Export to CSV
text: Export sessions Settings → Export Sessions. Pick a period and share a CSV file. Money is in each session's own currency. Opening the file Numbers, Excel and Google Sheets open the file directly.

title: Backups and sync
text: On your iPhone Your sessions, hands and bankrolls are stored on your iPhone. Backups Your data is included in your iPhone's iCloud or computer backup. Sync between devices Pokerlog doesn't sync between devices yet.

title: Free and Pro
text: Pokerlog is free to use. Pro shows why and where you win. What's free Logging cash games and tournaments, live sessions, one bankroll, statistics for the last 30 days, up to 10 recorded hands, CSV export, reminders and responsible play limits. What Pro adds Any period in statistics, breakdowns and the results calendar, more metrics and charts, unlimited hands, several bankrolls and currencies, tournament extras, the Lock Screen card and more widgets. Your data stays yours Everything you saved stays visible, editable and exportable after Pro ends.

title: Manage or restore a purchase
text: Manage or cancel Settings → Manage Subscription, or the Settings app → your name → Subscriptions. Restore a purchase Settings → Help → Restore Purchases. Refunds Refunds are handled by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.

title: FAQ
headings: How do I move my data to a new iPhone?
text: Is Pokerlog a gambling app? No. Pokerlog only records the games you play. It has no real-money games and no betting. Does Pokerlog work offline? Yes. Everything except Smart Hand and Suggest an Idea works without the internet. Can I use several currencies? Yes. Each place and session keeps its own currency. How do I move my data to a new iPhone?

title: Contact support
